title: Infrastructure Cloud Cost Optimization
description:
We're looking for a GCP cost optimization expert for a one-off sprint to reduce cloud spend across our SaaS infrastructure. The work centers on Cloud Run, Cloud Logging, Cloud SQL, and ClickHouse, including a Cloud Run cost regression and longer-term cost governance.

The objective of the mission is to define the actions to take in order to globally reduce GCP costs, both acting on infrastructure and code logic if necessary; and to apply those changes, while keeping/improving the current quality of service.

Technical stack:
Core product: a REST API platform (Node.js/TypeScript) serving real-time traffic for e-commerce websites, plus Python ML/recommendation services — all deployed as containerized autoscaling services on Cloud Run, behind a global HTTPS load balancer with CDN

Data & ingestion pipeline: 30+ containerized batch jobs (Cloud Run jobs) handling product catalog imports, image processing, ML embeddings, and analytics aggregation — some scheduled, some event-driven - Databases: PostgreSQL (Cloud SQL, HA) as the main transactional store; a self-hosted ClickHouse cluster on 2× n2-highmem-16 VMs powering analytics dashboards and observability - Supporting infra: Elasticsearch-backed search, BigQuery for analytics/exports, GCS for catalog files and assets, a small fleet of utility VMs (outbound IP-whitelisted proxy, observability stack), VPC connectors for private networking - Traffic profile: steady daytime API load (B2C end-users via retailer websites) + heavy nightly batch processing
